listeningWaiverText:
Founder listening decision: waived for this stage.
Runtime-audit assumption: every current MPV2 Clara and Marcus asset is assumed to contain its source-expected wording, be intelligible, and have acceptable pronunciation, tone, level, and technical quality.
Verification status: assumed-pass-by-founder, not human-verified.
Residual risk: audible wording or quality defects may still be discovered later during device QA or beta use.

findings.title: Chair active measurement starts without spoken countdown or audible go
findings.userConsequence: The 30-second chair window starts from an internal timer before the user receives an explicit audible start moment; this can invalidate measurement timing and eyes-off usability.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/movementProfileV2/liveCoordinator.ts:45 (chair countdown is internal 3000 ms) | src/movementProfileV2/liveCoordinator.ts:444 (chair active measurement starts at countdownStartedAt + 3000 ms) | src/movementProfileV2/voiceCues.ts:182 (transition-to-cue mapping is defined in resolveMovementProfileV2CueIdsForTransition)
findings.currentTestCoverage: src/movementProfileV2/__tests__/liveCoordinator.test.ts covers active transition; no runtime audio-onset test covers go.
findings.notes: The official-ready asset is longer than 3000 ms for both voices even before startup latency.

findings.title: User actions can deterministically drop essential setup guidance
findings.userConsequence: The UI can advance state while equal or higher-priority prior speech is still busy; distinct instructions are dropped rather than queued.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/audio/voicePlayer.ts:111 (lower-or-equal priority speak() calls return false while busy) | src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:170 (button actions call coordinator immediately and do not wait for voice completion) | src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:125 (transition speech is emitted from a live snapshot effect)
findings.currentTestCoverage: src/audio/__tests__/voicePlayer.test.ts covers lower-priority drop; no full MPV2 user-action collision regression exists.

findings.title: Required MPV2 cue failure is not fail-closed end to end
findings.userConsequence: A required instruction can be skipped while the controller continues and measurement can still start silently.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/audio/voicePlayer.ts:137 (missing asset/player creation errors are caught and skipped, with pending cues continuing) | src/audio/voicePlayer.ts:162 (playback start errors are caught and skipped, with pending cues continuing) | src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:170 (button actions call coordinator immediately and do not wait for voice completion)
findings.currentTestCoverage: Existing tests assert no crash/busy for missing/playback-start; they do not assert controller blocking.

findings.title: State progression does not observe voice completion for timed captures
findings.userConsequence: The user can enter a measurement or leave the screen before essential start/setup/completion narration finishes.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:170 (button actions call coordinator immediately and do not wait for voice completion) | src/movementProfileV2/liveCoordinator.ts:416 (hinge active starts on button action without a start cue) | src/movementProfileV2/liveCoordinator.ts:444 (chair active measurement starts at countdownStartedAt + 3000 ms)
findings.currentTestCoverage: Coordinator tests cover state transitions but not voice-completion gating.

findings.title: Completion or transition speech can be cancelled or stale across meaningful state exit
findings.userConsequence: Check-up completion may be cut off by navigation; if not unmounted, prior stage speech can continue into a new stage.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:97 (unmount/background path stops voice playback) | src/audio/voicePlayer.ts:149 (released/stale player completion callbacks are ignored by identity guard) | src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:125 (transition speech is emitted from a live snapshot effect)
findings.currentTestCoverage: No full-screen navigation/voice cancellation regression found.

findings.title: Shared tracking-loss/recovered/retry cues are bundled but not emitted
findings.userConsequence: Some recovery branches are silent or rely on screen text, weakening voice-first recovery.
findings.currentTestCoverage: Voice cue tests cover definitions; no test expects these cues to be emitted.

findings.title: Missing playback completion callback can leave VoiceChannel busy indefinitely
findings.userConsequence: Future lower/equal-priority guidance can be dropped until a higher-priority cue interrupts or the screen calls stop().
findings.sourceEvidence: src/audio/voicePlayer.ts:149 (released/stale player completion callbacks are ignored by identity guard) | src/audio/voicePlayer.ts:111 (lower-or-equal priority speak() calls return false while busy)
findings.currentTestCoverage: No existing test models absent didJustFinish callback.

findings.title: Background/foreground does not replay essential context and may model transition speech after stop
findings.userConsequence: A user returning from background may not hear the context needed to recover the current stage.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:97 (unmount/background path stops voice playback) | src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:125 (transition speech is emitted from a live snapshot effect)
findings.currentTestCoverage: Coordinator background tests exist; screen-level voice/AppState effect ordering is not covered.

findings.title: Mounted VoiceChannel does not rebuild when selected voice changes
findings.userConsequence: Changing trainer voice while the screen is mounted does not affect the current session channel.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:71 (VoiceChannel is captured in React state and is not rebuilt when voiceId prop changes)
findings.currentTestCoverage: No screen-level voice-change lifecycle test found.

findings.title: Current MPV2 balance protocol differs from future V2.1 staged ladder
findings.userConsequence: Runtime is internally coherent, but spec/test language must not imply the full V2.1 ladder is implemented.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/movementProfileV2/liveCoordinator.ts:459 (current balance is one-leg, max 45000 ms, up to 3 valid trials)
findings.currentTestCoverage: Live coordinator tests cover current single-leg attempt flow.

findings.title: Higher-priority recovery can interrupt useful in-progress instructions
findings.userConsequence: The interruption is policy-compliant, but interrupted lower-priority setup context is not replayed after recovery.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/audio/voicePlayer.ts:112 (higher-priority speak() calls stop current playback before starting new request)

findings.title: No audit-regression test locks the full voice timeline
findings.userConsequence: Future changes could reintroduce drops/timing regressions without a targeted fake-clock test.
findings.sourceEvidence: src/screens/MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen.tsx:125 (transition speech is emitted from a live snapshot effect)
findings.currentTestCoverage: Existing tests cover pieces, not the integrated voice timeline.

limitations: Listening review was waived; audio wording and quality are assumed for this audit and not human-verified.
The timing model uses measured MP3 durations plus synthetic startup/completion callback delays; it is not native playback-onset measurement.
The harness models React/controller event order from source and tests but does not instantiate React Native or expo-audio.
The current worktree was already dirty and contains unrelated source changes; this audit only adds audit artifacts and an audit-only harness.
